A.biggest_strength: A fully live interactive laboratory with real-time computation, dual synchronized charts (parabola trajectory and loss-over-time decay), side-by-side small multiples, and an explicit hand-calculated walkthrough that lets students verify every number immediately.
A.biggest_weakness: The step update is shown only as a line connecting successive points on the loss curve rather than an explicit vector arrow along the parameter axis.

B.biggest_strength: Rich color-coded visual grammar connecting algebraic terms to diagram elements, along with helpful contextual notes explaining real-world ML extensions (SGD mini-batches, momentum, Adam, and multi-dimensional weights).
B.biggest_weakness: Rigid canned data with an aggressive auto-tour timer that continually wrests control from the reader, combined with an active learning-rate slider displaying an erroneous 0.75 during scenes explaining 0.05, 0.25, and 1.05.
factual_errors: In Scene 2 prose, the step size calculation drops the slope's sign stating '0.25 × 4 = 1' instead of multiplying the learning rate by the negative slope (-4) or specifying absolute value magnitude.
In Scenes 1 through 5, the interface presents a visible learning-rate slider displaying 'η = 0.75', contradicting the actual learning rates (0.05, 0.25, 1.05) active and described in those scenes.
